name: Scenario AN: Last-Minute Opening Alert
comments: Triggered by a Calendly invitee.canceled webhook. Checks Google Calendar for the freed slot, emails the business owner the open time, then generates and sends personalized AI outreach emails via Resend to the top 3 HubSpot contacts tagged waitlist=true. HubSpot notes are logged for each outreach. Error route sends an internal alert via Resend. All secrets stored as env.VARIABLE_NAME. Timezone: America/New_York.

metadata.notes: Fires on every Calendly webhook. Filter passes only invitee.canceled events. Payload contains payload.payload.event.start_time, payload.payload.event.end_time, payload.payload.invitee.name, payload.payload.invitee.email.
Verifies the cancelled slot is now truly free on Google Calendar. If length(2.items)==0 the slot is open and we proceed to notify.

Open Slot Available

A cancellation just opened up a slot on your calendar.

Date & Time{{formatDate(1.body.payload.event.start_time; \"dddd, MMMM D, YYYY [at] h:mm A\"; \"America/New_York\")}} ET

You can also share the direct booking link: {{env.CALENDLY_BOOKING_LINK}}

CWI AI | cwiai.net

metadata.notes: Emails the business owner (brian@cwiai.net) the freed slot details immediately. Runs regardless of whether the slot is confirmed empty on GCal — the calendar check (module 2) is informational context.

webhooks.name: Calendly Canceled Webhook (hook 3050)
webhooks.notes: Register this webhook URL in Calendly > Integrations > Webhooks for event type invitee.canceled. Make generates the real URL when the scenario is imported and activated.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.label: OpenRouter API Key
OPENROUTER_API_KEY.notes: Bearer token for OpenRouter. Primary model: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6.

CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS.label: Internal Alert From Address
CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS.notes: Verified sender for internal error alerts.

RESEND_REPLY_TO.label: Resend Reply-To
RESEND_REPLY_TO.notes: Reply-to address on all Resend emails.

CALENDLY_BOOKING_LINK.label: Calendly Booking Link
CALENDLY_BOOKING_LINK.notes: Self-service booking link included in outreach emails.

notes.label: Module 1 — Calendly Webhook
notes.note: Fires on every Calendly event. Filter passes only invitee.canceled payloads so other event types are ignored.

notes.label: Module 2 — Google Calendar: Verify Freed Slot
notes.note: Queries the cancelled slot window on Google Calendar to confirm it is now free before contacting waitlisted contacts.

notes.label: Module 3 — Resend: Notify Business Owner
notes.note: Immediately emails brian@cwiai.net with the freed slot details and confirms AI outreach is being sent.

notes.label: Modules 4–8 — HubSpot Waitlist Loop
notes.note: Fetches top 3 waitlisted contacts (oldest first), iterates with BasicFeeder, generates a personalised Claude email for each, sends via Resend, and logs a HubSpot note per contact.
